opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget. Capital and project grants approximately 10-20% of costs. Local community capital projects typically up to £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for UK charities for operating/core costs, capital projects, and projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Covers sectors including arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums & heritage, welfare, and youth.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1m). Must be an eligible UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) advised to apply for a regular grant instead.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over for UK charities. Considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Submit an Expression of Interest all year round with no deadlines; reviewed on a rolling basis.
